Exact crop of the published Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side), PDF page 25: the slip of [[Forced Servitude (V) (Errata 3)]] (official text as of 27 April 2013; PDF built February 2014). It prints errata version PC-E3 (“Deploy on table. Your troopers are Heroic. Opponent's total weapon destiny targeting your Heroic card is +2. When opponent is about to remove their last card from Life Force, you may first place all your troopers in Used Pile (last card must still be removed). [Immune to Alter]”), word for word the text of [[Forced Servitude (V)]].<ref>[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Master List (Dark Side)]]. Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>
